description_en: Queries the details of an application by calling QueryAppInfo
name: QueryAppInfo

parameters.help_en: The AppKey of the application, which uniquely identifies the application
parameters.help_zh: 指定应用的AppKey，用于唯一标识应用
parameters.name: app_key

AppInfo.description_en: The basic information about the application

AppKey.description_en: The AppKey of the application, which uniquely identifies the application
AppKey.description_zh: 应用的AppKey，用于唯一标识应用

BundleId.description_en: The BundleId of the iOS application

CertDevelopAvail.description_en: Indicates whether the push development certificate is available in the push configuration
CertDevelopAvail.description_zh: 标识推送配置开发者推送证书是否可用

CertDevelopExpiration.description_en: The expiration time of the push development certificate. The time is in UTC
CertDevelopExpiration.description_zh: 推送开发者证书过期时间。UTC格式表达

CertProductAvail.description_en: Indicates whether the push production certificate is available in the push configuration
CertProductAvail.description_zh: 推送配置生产推送证书是否可用

CertProductExpiration.description_en: The expiration time of the push production certificate. The time is in UTC
CertProductExpiration.description_zh: 推送生产证书过期时间。UTC格式表达

CreateTime.description_en: The time when the application was created. The time is in UTC
CreateTime.description_zh: 应用创建时间。UTC格式表达

EncodedIcon.description_en: The Base64-encoded string of the icon image

PackageName.description_en: The package name of the Android application

ProductId.description_en: The ID of the workspace to which the application belongs

Readonly.description_en:
Indicates whether the application is in read-only state.

This field is used in specific scenarios. You can ignore it if not needed

标识应用是否为只读状态。

该字段用于特定场景，如无需要可忽略

Status.description_en:
The application status. Valid values:

0: Normal. 

-1: Deleted. 

-2: Permanently deleted
